tips.text: Wait for a natural 60% roll in Eleanor's shop instead of starting the fusion grind; Torxica has come up at 60% more often than most Coda weapons.
Buy any roll of 52.8% or higher on sight; one fusion with it takes your main copy straight to 60%.
Ignore the element on a roll and judge only the percentage; if you get to pick one, Magnetic is the usual choice.
Reach Mastery Rank 17 before you bank Heartcells; Eleanor enforces it and Heartcells cannot be traded.
Vanquish the Coda at the Concert, never Convert; only a Vanquish pays Heartcells.
Hunt the Duet inside the Antivirus Bounty so one run pays Hex standing, Antivirus mods and disinfection.
Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the progress banks immediately.
Slot Quick Correct once you know the Antivirus; each correct stab has a 10% chance of a free Heartcell for the whole squad.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin skips shields.
Run the Concert solo if time matters; a full squad takes 12 to 20 minutes because every player's Coda gets its own fight.
Run the Concert in a public squad for extra Heartcells; each squadmate who defeats their own Coda adds one.
Check the name before you grind; Dual Toxocyst is a different weapon with its own Incarnon.
Expect the Coda itself to take one to two hours; the wait for Eleanor's rotation is the real grind.
